media.title: The Mango Season
media.content:
The Mango Season

January in the village is always welcomed because it is the peak of the mango season. The branches of the huge, ancient trees bend low under the weight of sweet, juicy fruits. Boys climb up the sturdy branches to pick the ripe mangoes while girls wait below with baskets. Everyone's face is sticky and yellow from enjoying the delicious fresh fruit under the shade. It is a sweet time of year when nature provides a free feast for the whole community.

questions.text: Why do children welcome the month of January in the village?
options: Because it is the peak of the mango season
Because they receive new winter jackets
Because they get to swim in the cold river
questions.answer: Because it is the peak of the mango season
